tools.name: verify_record
tools.description: Verify an Eformogi receipt id with no login and no API key: the same check the public /verify page performs. Returns the kind, the title or course fields, the issued date, and the signers' names and identity levels, worded exactly as the page words them. Never an email, a user id, or a person id.

tools.name: how_eformogi_works
tools.description: What Eformogi is and what it costs: the thesis sentence and the pricing paragraph, verbatim, plus the key public pages.

tools.name: read_spec
tools.description: Read the open Eformogi record standard published at /spec. With no chapter, lists every published chapter. With a chapter slug, returns that chapter's markdown text.

tools.name: read_door
tools.description: Read the facts sheet behind one door grant a student shared: the door, the sums, the lines, the plain text, the page link if there is one, and the receipt id on any item that carries one, for a receiver's own agent to hand to verify_record. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: verify_record, read_door · Private data: verify_record, read_spec, read_door · Public sink: verify_record.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: verify_record, read_door · Private data: verify_record, read_spec, read_door · Public sink: verify_record

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
